text: Standardizing private fund adviser reporting obligations is the author's proposed remedy for the shortcomings advisers identified, because standardization attacks the ambiguity and inefficiency in the reporting requirements at their source and simplifies the disclosure regime.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Private Fund Disclosures Under the Dodd-Frank Act (2014). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2447306

isBasedOn.name: Private Fund Disclosures Under the Dodd-Frank Act

abstract: Standardization may help address the ambiguities and inefficiencies that currently exist in the reporting requirements and help simplify and streamline the disclosure requirements for the private fund industry.
